title: Token-2022 confidential transfer authority
detects: An authority governing confidential transfers: which accounts may use them, and the auditor key able to decrypt the amounts of those that do.
knownFalseNegative: Read as admin-authority, not as a transfer restriction: the approval gate applies only to the confidential path, and a holder refused approval can still transfer normally. The auditorElgamalPubkey field is reported as a detail rather than scored, because it is a surveillance key rather than a control key. Whether that key can be rotated or added on a live mint is not clearly stated in the documentation reachable at the time of writing, and is deliberately not asserted here in either direction.

coversExamples.observed: PRESENT, authority 2apBGMsS6ti9RyF5TwQTDswXBWskiJP2LD4cUEDqYJjk, autoApproveNewAccounts false and no auditor key set

rationale: An authority that decides who may transact confidentially, and who may read those transactions, is a power over holders. Without this pattern it was invisible.
